name: chit-chat
description: Application to facilitate file exchange between devices on local network

scripts.start: docker compose up redis mongo -d && concurrently -n backend,frontend -c blue,green "npm start -w backend" "npm run dev -w frontend"
scripts.dev: concurrently -n backend,frontend -c blue,green "npm start -w backend" "npm run dev -w frontend"
scripts.start:app: npm run start:server & npm run start:client & electron main.js

author: Vladyslav Nosal
